title: SmartSubs Pro v2.9.7
notes: A polish and control update. Captions now stay on screen until the phrase is finished (adjustable with 'Hold captions longer'), numbers like 5.000 no longer get a stray space, and hooks stay selective instead of firing on every line. A new Custom Vocabulary teaches the AI your names and brands so they're spelled right, and optional AI Text Correction fixes misheard words while keeping the timing aligned. The interface also got a full pass: one consistent icon set, on/off toggle switches, cleaner inputs and helpful tooltips.
